description_text: Proposed procurement for NSN 1005016583419 CHUTE ASSEMBLY,AMM: Line 0001 Qty 13 UI AY Deliver To: By: 0105 DAYS ADO This Solicitation may result in an Automated IDC (Indefinite Delivery Contract). All responsible sources may submit a quote which, if timely received, shall be considered. Quotes must be submitted electronically.
